name: MOPOP Volunteer
what_you_do: Help guests at the Museum of Pop Culture. Answer questions, help with the hands-on exhibits and lead activities.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16 years old and pass a background check and a reference check.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers get free admission with a guest, special events, discounts and parking help.
duration: At least 6 months, one shift every other week (9:45 a.m. to 1 p.m. or 1 to 4 p.m.)
deadline_text: You can apply now. The next round of reviews starts in spring 2027, and MOPOP will contact you then.
how_to_apply: Fill in the general volunteer application (ages 16 and up) on the volunteer page. If your background and times fit, MOPOP sets up an interview. Questions: volunteers@mopop.org.
notes: MOPOP will verify service-learning hours for school. Its summer Youth Volunteer program for high schoolers 16 and 17 is paused; it last ran July 9 to Aug 20, 2025. Sound Off!, its showcase for musicians 21 and under, is paused in 2027.
